story.en: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha walks in: "We need top earning drivers per city for bonus distribution." Time to combine trips and drivers data.
story.ta: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha vandhu sonnaanga: "City-wise top earning drivers venum — bonus kudukanum." Trips-um drivers-um join panna time.
story.hi: Uber HQ, Friday shaam. Product manager Sneha bolti hai: "Har city ke top earning drivers chahiye — bonus dena hai." Trips aur drivers ko join karna padega.
story.te: Uber HQ, Friday evening. Product manager Sneha cheppindi: "City-wise top earning drivers kavali — bonus ivvali." Trips mariyu drivers ni join cheyyali.

question.en: Find total earnings of each driver and show top 3 earning drivers per city.
question.ta: Oru driver evlo total earn pannirukkaan nu calculate panni, city-ku top 3 earning drivers kaatu.
question.hi: Har driver ka total earning nikalo aur har city ke top 3 drivers dikhao.
question.te: Prathi driver total earnings calculate chesi, prathi city lo top 3 drivers chupinchu.

title.hi: Drivers aur trips ko join karo
title.te: Drivers mariyu trips ni join cheyyali

explain.en: JOIN combines rows from both tables using driver_id as the key. Without join, trips and drivers stay disconnected — you can see trip amounts but don't know which city they belong to.
explain.ta: JOIN rendu tables-a driver_id use panni connect pannum. Join panna marandha trips-um drivers-um separate-aa dhaan irukkum — amount theriyum aana city theriyaadhu.
explain.hi: JOIN driver_id ke basis pe dono tables ko connect karta hai. Join nahi kiya toh trips aur drivers alag-alag rehte hain — fare toh dikh raha hai lekin city nahi pata.
explain.te: JOIN driver_id base meeda rendu tables ni connect chestundi. Join cheyyakapoina trips mariyu drivers separate ga untaayi — fare kanapadutundi kaani city telusukoledu.

title.hi: Driver ke hisaab se total earnings nikalo

steps.sql:
SELECT d.driver_id,
       d.driver_name,
       d.city,
       SUM(t.fare) AS total_earnings
FROM drivers d
JOIN trips t ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city
ORDER BY total_earnings DESC;

explain.en: SUM(fare) adds up all trip fares per driver. GROUP BY ensures the sum is calculated separately for each driver. ORDER BY total_earnings DESC shows highest earner first.
explain.ta: SUM(fare) oru driver-oda ella trips-oda fare-a add pannum. GROUP BY driver-wise calculate pannum. ORDER BY DESC highest earner mudhal varum.
explain.hi: SUM(fare) har driver ke saare trips ka fare jod deta hai. GROUP BY har driver ke liye alag calculate karta hai. ORDER BY DESC sabse zyada earning wala pehle.
explain.te: SUM(fare) oka driver anni trips fares ni add chestundi. GROUP BY prathi driver ki alagugaa calculate chestundi. ORDER BY DESC highest earner mundu vasthadu.

title.en: Get top 3 drivers per city using ROW_NUMBER
title.ta: ROW_NUMBER use panni city-ku top 3 drivers kaatu
title.hi: ROW_NUMBER se har city ke top 3 drivers nikalo
title.te: ROW_NUMBER use chesi prathi city lo top 3 drivers kanugonu

steps.sql:
SELECT driver_id, driver_name, city, total_earnings
FROM (
  SELECT d.driver_id,
         d.driver_name,
         d.city,
         SUM(t.fare) AS total_earnings,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY d.city
           ORDER BY SUM(t.fare) DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN trips t ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
  GROUP BY d.driver_id, d.driver_name, d.city
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3;

explain.en: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY earnings DESC) assigns rank 1 to the highest earner in each city, rank 2 to the second, and so on. PARTITION BY city means ranking restarts for every new city. WHERE rn <= 3 keeps only the top 3 per city.
explain.ta: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY earnings DESC) prathi city-la highest earner-ku rank 1, next-ku rank 2 kudukum. PARTITION BY city = prathi city-ku ranking restart. WHERE rn <= 3 = top 3 mattum vachu.
explain.hi: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY earnings DESC) har city mein highest earner ko rank 1, uske baad rank 2 deta hai. PARTITION BY city matlab ranking har city ke liye restart. WHERE rn <= 3 sirf top 3 rakhta hai.
explain.te: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY earnings DESC) prathi city lo highest earner ki rank 1, tarvata rank 2 isthundi. PARTITION BY city ante ranking prathi city ki restart avutundi. WHERE rn <= 3 ante top 3 maatrame.
